weeklyComparer.title: DIAM Weekly Comparison
weeklyComparer.subtitle: See customer increases, decreases and monthly shifts at a glance.
weeklyComparer.scope: First worksheet only, including hidden rows. Match by Team + Entity + External/Group + Customer (Bill to). Identity changes appear as removed/added records. No currency conversion or inferred order status.
weeklyComparer.precision: Overview amounts show 2 decimals; details and CSV retain source precision. ∅ means missing, never zero.
weeklyComparer.referenceNote: Only data changes are displayed. Formula edits with unchanged values and weekly reference-column rollover are excluded. Exports contain all data changes regardless of screen filters.
weeklyComparer.emptySummary: Choose the previous and current weekly files to compare.

weeklyOrders.title: DIAM Project Weekly Comparison
weeklyOrders.subtitle: Compare on-going-DDC projects across two source files.
weeklyOrders.opportunity.subtitle: Compare the previous opportunity list with the current on-going-DDC sheet.
weeklyOrders.opportunity.scope: Match project codes to Job Numbers. For repeated codes, use Opportunity Name and Project Name. Compare the previous Expected Close Date with the current Invoice Date (T).
weeklyOrders.opportunity.amountNote: Previous expected revenue is assigned to its settlement currency. Currency deltas are unavailable where the previous export does not report that currency or the amount is missing.
weeklyOrders.opportunity.errorTemplate: Expected exactly one sheet in {file} with project code, opportunity name, settlement currency, expected revenue, sales stage, and expected close date headers.
weeklyOrders.opportunity.unknownCurrency: Settlement currency is missing or outside RMB, USD, and EUR. Expected revenue cannot be assigned to an amount column.
weeklyOrders.scope: Read only on-going-DDC. Match Job Number (E); repeated jobs are separated by Project Name (K). Remaining same-job/name rows are compared as one group. Only N/O/P, Invoice Date (T) and status (L) are compared.
weeklyOrders.sameNote: Same status includes the Chinese and English equivalents for design, prototype, quotation, and production. Each status must occur the same number of times. Amounts or dates may still differ.
weeklyOrders.groupNote: Amounts are grouped by currency. All source rows and each status/date are retained. No row-number matching, fuzzy project-name matching or status spelling correction is inferred.
weeklyOrders.amountNote: N = RMB, O = USD, P = EUR. Never add currencies together. Blank / TBC amounts stay unavailable; charts include only comparable known amounts.
weeklyOrders.chooseProject: Click a project to see all before / after source rows.
weeklyOrders.dataOnly: Only data changes; formula edits and other worksheets are excluded.
weeklyOrders.ready: Choose two reports. Only on-going-DDC is compared.
weeklyOrders.loaded: Source rows: {old} → {new}; showing {count} project groups; review {review}.
weeklyOrders.noStatusChanges: No status changes in this selection.
weeklyOrders.missingJob: Job Number is missing; this row is retained for review, not automatically matched.
weeklyOrders.missingData: A requested source value is unavailable.
weeklyOrders.errorSheet: The required on-going-DDC sheet is missing in {file}.
weeklyOrders.errorTemplate: Columns in {file} do not match the on-going-DDC template: D/E/G/K/L/N/O/P/T.
weeklyOrders.errorEmpty: No project rows found in on-going-DDC in {file}.
weeklyOrders.missingProject: Repeated Job Number has no Project Name; retained for review.

monthlyDetail.title: Team & customer monthly Sales
monthlyDetail.sourceNote: Actual Sales in kEUR. YTD compares January through the source cutoff in both years. Sparse blank allocations reconcile to the supplied totals. Source: {source}
monthlyDetail.loadError: Monthly Sales details could not be loaded. Reopen this view to retry.
monthlyDetail.scope: Monthly team and customer details require access to all China entities, with All Entities and All sales selected.
monthlyDetail.noSource: No published monthly team/customer detail source is available for this year.
pipeline.cohortNote: Projects are grouped by their earliest creation week. Status and stage come from the selected snapshot. Weekly shows new-project cohorts; YTD accumulates those cohorts.
pipeline.projectStatusNote: Won records are excluded from this panel, including its total. Projects can occur in both In progress and Lost when their underlying records have different statuses.
pipeline.stageProjectNote: Stages use the selected snapshot. A project can occur in multiple stages when its underlying records differ.
monthlyDetail.importRule: China monthly team/customer actual Sales. Entity allocations are not supplied. Both YTD years use the source cutoff month. Weekly sources and approved budgets are separate.
